+def get_isbn_10_and_13(isbns: str | list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Split ISBN values into canonical ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 lists."""
+    from openlibrary.utils.isbn import normalize_isbn
+
+    if isinstance(isbns, str):
+        isbns = [isbns]
+    elif not isinstance(isbns, list):
+        return [], []
+
+    isbn_10 = []
+    isbn_13 = []
+    for isbn in isbns:
+        if not isinstance(isbn, str):
+            continue
+        normalized = normalize_isbn(isbn.strip())
+        if not normalized:
+            continue
+        normalized = normalized.upper()
+        if len(normalized) == 10 and normalized[:-1].isdigit() and normalized[-1] in '0123456789X':
+            isbn_10.append(normalized)
+        elif len(normalized) == 13 and normalized.isdigit():
+            isbn_13.append(normalized)
+
+    return sorted(isbn_10), sorted(isbn_13)
+
+
+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Split publisher metadata into publisher names and publication places."""
+    if isinstance(publishers, str):
+        publishers = [publishers]
+    elif not isinstance(publishers, list):
+        return [], []
+
+    publisher_names = []
+    publish_places = []
+    for value in publishers:
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        value = value.strip()
+        if not value:
+            continue
+
+        place, separator, publisher = value.partition(':')
+        if separator:
+            place = place.strip()
+            publisher = publisher.strip()
+            if place and publisher:
+                publish_places.append(place)
+                publisher_names.append(publisher)
+            elif publisher:
+                publisher_names.append(publisher)
+        else:
+            publisher_names.append(value)
+
+    return publisher_names, publish_places
+
